findings.defect: The draft makes Cheongpung the person who apologized, but the omitted subject is the young prodigies who apologized before Cheongpung beat one of them.
findings.rationale: The surrounding exchange distinguishes the offenders' apology from Martial Uncle Cheongpung personally administering the beating.
findings.replacement: Of course, they apologized before that.

findings.current: At my words, the sharp ones quietly let their eyes shine, while the slow ones cautiously opened their mouths.
findings.defect: Both singular individuals are changed into plural groups.
findings.rationale: The source contrasts one perceptive heir with one oblivious heir, and only the latter proceeds to speak.
findings.replacement: At my words, the quick-witted one’s eyes quietly gleamed, while the clueless one cautiously opened his mouth.
findings.source: 내 말에 눈치 빠른 놈은 조용히 눈을 반짝였고, 눈치 없는 놈은 조심스럽게 입을 열었다.

findings.current:
“……”

“He did not wish to speak any further about that day.”
findings.defect: Taekyung’s spoken question is omitted, and Zhu Bao’s first-person refusal is changed into third-person narration about someone else.
findings.rationale: The source contains two distinct dialogue turns: Taekyung reacts to Jin Mukyung’s silence, then Zhu Bao refuses to discuss the painful memory further.
findings.replacement:
“He didn’t say a single word?”

“I do not wish to speak of that day anymore.”
findings.source:
“……아무 말도 안 했다고요?”

“그날에 대한 얘기는 더 이상하기 싫다.”

findings.defect: The draft invents a male subject and frames the thought as agreement with Hong Jin rather than Taekyung’s own realization.
findings.rationale: The source is a subjectless realization leading into Taekyung’s explanation of who will make the decision.

findings.current: They were nominally part of the orthodox Murim. If we seized whatever we wanted and demanded accountability like mounted bandits, everyone would point fingers at us.
findings.defect: The first sentence assigns orthodox-faction membership to the minor sects rather than to Taekyung’s side, weakening the causal explanation for why the Jin Family cannot openly behave like bandits.
findings.rationale: The source explains that the Jin Family’s own orthodox affiliation requires a legitimate pretext for its actions.
findings.replacement: We belonged to the orthodox faction, after all. If we seized whatever we wanted and held people accountable like a band of mounted bandits, everyone would point fingers at us.
findings.source: 명색이 정파 무림 소속인데, 마적 떼처럼 닥치는 대로 뺏고 책임을 물었다가는 손가락질을 받을 테니까.

findings.current: It’s nice that I can take a cut of the profits, too.
findings.defect: The draft makes the benefit explicitly financial, while the source euphemistically refers to picking up incidental spoils or benefits.
findings.rationale: 떡고물 preserves a figurative, noncommittal reference to benefits gained from the scheme rather than specifying profits.
findings.replacement: And it doesn’t hurt that I can pick up a few crumbs along the way.

findings.defect: The neutral wording removes Taekyung’s vulgar contempt for their absurd performance.
findings.rationale: 지랄 is strongly vulgar here and characterizes the exaggerated claims of amnesia as ridiculous behavior.
findings.replacement: *They’re really putting on a fucking show.*

findings.current: If a major sect like Huashan got angry, their entire families might get beaten with a bat.
findings.defect: The draft replaces Huashan’s explicit membership in the Nine Sects and One Gang with the generic description “a major sect,” losing the institutional hierarchy behind the threat.
findings.rationale: 구파일방 is an established organization whose prestige explains why the small Shanxi sects are terrified of provoking Huashan.
findings.replacement: If Huashan, one of the Nine Sects and One Gang, got angry, even their extended families might get beaten with a bat.
findings.source: 구파일방인 화산파가 열받으면 일가친척까지 빠따를 맞을 수도 있다.

findings.current:
Looking at the little boy’s dejected face made me feel a little guilty.

For about half a second.

I wanted to get back to the main family and sleep for a long time.
findings.defect: The draft adds a specific half-second duration, weakens the profane self-correction, renders 본가 unnaturally as “the main family,” and changes resting properly into sleeping for a long time.
findings.rationale: The source immediately and profanely retracts the hint of guilt before stating that Taekyung wants to return to his family and rest well.
findings.replacement: Looking at the dejected kid’s face made me feel a little guilty—like hell it did. I wanted to hurry back home to my family and get some proper rest.
findings.source: 시무룩한 꼬맹이의 얼굴을 보니 살짝 죄책감이 들기는 개뿔, 얼른 본가로 돌아가서 푹 쉬고 싶다.

summary: Three critical fidelity errors alter subjects or quantities; additional findings concern hierarchy, register, explicitness, and localized wording.
